title: Umphefumlo Onobubele Phakathi KwabaProfeti
intro: Ilizwi elibiza ubulungisa livakala kwiindinyana zeQuran eNgcwele. Lo mphefumlo ungcwele wanikwa isiprofeto nezibhalo ezingcwele ngexesha apho ulwalathiso lwalufuneka kakhulu phakathi kwabantwana bakwaSirayeli. Lo mntu wathetha ngqo nabantu bakhe, ebakhuthaza ukuba bakhumbule iNkosi yabo. Ngomonde nokuzinikela, baba sisibane sokukhanya esikhanyisa amaphepha ezibhalo ezingcwele. Ungamchaza lo mntu umangalisayo ogama lakhe lihlonitshwayo kwiQuran nakwiVangeli?
clues: Ndazukiswa ngokuba ngumprofeti nencwadi yasezulwini ngexesha lokuswela kwabantu bam.
Umama wandizala ngendlela ephawulekayo, ngomyalelo kaThixo kuphela.
Ndathetha nabantu bam, ndisithi, 'Owu Bantwana bakwaSirayeli! Ndingumthunywa ka-Allah kuni, oqinisekisa oko bekuphambi kwam.'
Ndize nemiqondiso ecacileyo evela eNkosini yakho, ndizisa iindaba ezimnandi zomprofeti ogama lakhe linguAhmad.
Umama wayengumfazi olilungisa owandinikela enkonzweni ka-Allah ukususela ebutsheni bam.
UAllah undifundise iQuran waza wandenza ndanovelwano nomonde kumama, kwaye bendingenakratshi okanye ndingathobeli.
arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
